rationale: bugs_open/006 §B follow-on, owner-directed 2026-07-24 (Option B of PLAN_2026-07-24_contact_form_hardening). The render-seam fix is live and proven (fundamentallyai.com self-converted on re-render), and the contact_form_undeliverable check is enabled — but the check is detection-only: every finding parks at needs_human_review even though all 10 affected sites now hold a real address in the sites.email column, where a light re-render would fix the form deterministically with no human in the loop. Two defects block turning the checker into a checker→handler pair: (1) the check cannot tell a self-repairable site from an address-less one, so it cannot route; (2) the light re-render path (page_rerender → rerender_page_sections) builds ctx.Email from buildRerenderBaseData, which reads ONLY sites.content_data.email — empty on 8 of the 10 affected sites and STALE on idea.uk (idea-uk@leopardess.uk vs the current idea.uk@contactforsales.com in the column) — while the full-writer path reads COALESCE(si.email,'') via loadSiteDataFull. So the cheap re-render could not deliver the fix the operator's data implies, and on idea.uk would bake a stale address into a mailto. The change: gate the check on sites.email resolvability (mirroring deliverableFormAction's guard, including the info@<own-domain> refusal) — resolvable → emit a page_rerender (handler page-rerender, reason section_data_resolved, distinct dedup key) that self-heals via the already-live sanitiseFormAction; address-less → the unchanged needs_human_review row. And make buildRerenderBaseData prefer the canonical sites.email column, applied after the content_data merge, so both render paths agree on the address source. The full-writer alternative (needs_page) was rejected: it regenerates copy via the LLM and risks the documented deployed-page bounce to needs_human_review at attempt 0. Committed cc2cff79b, inert until a chassis image roll.

plan.summary: Turn contact_form_undeliverable from detection-only into a gated checker→handler: sites with a resolvable sites.email get an auto-healing light page_rerender; address-less sites keep the human-review row. Fix buildRerenderBaseData to read the canonical sites.email column so the light re-render path agrees with the full-writer path on the address source.

edits.rationale: The check emitted one shape unconditionally: HandlerAgent='', Status='needs_human_review' — never dispatched (LoadWorkItemsAction selects only triaged/approved; triage promotes only detected). Correct for an address-less site, where auto-picking an address would guess. But for a site whose sites.email column holds a real address, the render seam's conversion is deterministic — sanitiseFormAction builds mailto:<sites.email> — so a light re-render executes the fix the operator's data already implies; no guess. resolveSiteContact reads COALESCE(email,''), COALESCE(domain,'') from sites once per run; contactAddressResolvable mirrors deliverableFormAction's guard exactly (non-empty, contains @, NOT info@<own-domain> — the synthesised display fallback two render paths set) and is commented to stay in lockstep. Resolvable → page_rerender item: HandlerAgent 'page-rerender', Status 'detected' (so TriageDetectedItemsAction promotes it and rewrites pipeline→build), Pipeline 'build', reason 'section_data_resolved' — routed by check_rerender_mode's conditional to rerender_page_sections (true template re-render, runs sanitiseFormAction) WITHOUT firing the cta_links_stale-gated CTA recompute; the conventional resolved-data reason already used by render_news_section_html and reconcile_section_data. ItemKey 'contact_form_undeliverable_rerender:<pageID>' is distinct from the human-review key so a page that gains an address later is not suppressed by a stale parked row, and distinct from create_rerender_items' pageRerenderItemKey format (check_misdirected_cta precedent: a check emitting page_rerender uses its own key namespace). Address-less branch byte-identical to before. Header's routing paragraph updated to document both branches so the file does not contradict itself.

The light re-render path's ambient base read ONLY sites.content_data (SELECT content_data FROM sites), mapping content_data.email → ctx.Email via mergeIntoRenderContext. The full-writer path reads the sites.email COLUMN (loadSiteDataFull: COALESCE(si.email,'')). Live divergence: content_data.email is empty on 8 of the 10 affected sites and stale on idea.uk — so the cheap page_rerender could not convert a dead form even where sites.email holds the address, and on idea.uk would have baked idea-uk@leopardess.uk into a mailto. Fix: read COALESCE(email,'') in the SAME single-row query, and apply it to base[email]/base[contact_email] AFTER the content_data merge so the canonical column wins over a stale content_data value; an empty column leaves the content_data value as the fallback (no regression for sites configured only via content_data). Not done inside deliverableFormAction because ctx.Email is display-ambient too — the column should win for every ambient consumer on this path, matching what the full-writer already does.

The check had zero tests. TestContactAddressResolvable pins the guard's parity with deliverableFormAction (real address / empty / malformed / info@own-domain refused case-insensitively / info@DIFFERENT-domain honoured / whitespace). TestContactFormUndeliverableRoutesByResolvability is the end-to-end routing guard via sqlmock: the SAME broken form (#contact) yields a page_rerender (handler page-rerender, status detected, rerender key) when the site row returns a resolvable address, and the needs_human_review shape (empty handler) when it returns '' or info@<own-domain>. Fault-injected: forcing resolvable=false made the resolvable-route case fail with HandlerAgent='' want 'page-rerender' before being trusted.

Pins the address-source contract for the light path: the sites.email column wins over a stale content_data.email (the idea.uk case, asserted with its literal values), an empty column falls back to content_data.email (no regression), and an empty content_data still gets the column address. Fault-injected: removing the column preference reproduced exactly the stale idea-uk@leopardess.uk assertion failure.

grounded_in: check_rerender_mode conditional (live agent_definitions, page-rerender): "input_data.spec.reason == 'image_landed' OR input_data.spec.reason == 'section_data_resolved' OR input_data.spec.reason == 'cta_links_stale'" — section_data_resolved routes to rerender_sections; the CTA recompute is gated separately on reason==cta_links_stale (rerender_page_sections_action.go:287 'CTA recompute — ONLY for reason=cta_links_stale').
rerender_page_sections_action.go:496-533 (pre-change): buildRerenderBaseData ran `SELECT content_data FROM sites WHERE id = $1` — no read of the email column anywhere in the function.
render_site_components_action.go loadSiteDataFull: `COALESCE(si.email,'')` scanned into s.Email — the full-writer path's address source.

Live audit 2026-07-24 (clients_db): all 10 sites with an undeliverable form have a resolvable sites.email (@contactforsales.com); content_data.email is absent for 8 of them and 'idea-uk@leopardess.uk' (stale) for idea.uk, whose sites.email is 'idea.uk@contactforsales.com'.

load_work_item_actions.go:559 selects status IN ('triaged','approved') only; triage_detect_items_action.go:88-101 promotes only status='detected' and rewrites pipeline→'build' — so the old needs_human_review shape never dispatches, and 'detected' is the correct status for an auto-handled item.
check_misdirected_cta.go:313-328: existing precedent of a discovery check emitting ItemType page_rerender with HandlerAgent 'page-rerender', Status 'detected', its own ItemKey namespace.

create_rerender_items_action.go:209: scoped := (reason == 'section_data_resolved' || reason == 'image_landed') && componentIDStr != '' — the scoped behaviour needs a component_id, which this check's spec does not carry, so reusing the reason does not trigger it.
component_library.go deliverableFormAction: the guard being mirrored — non-empty, strings.Contains '@', and strings.EqualFold(email, 'info@'+domain) refusal (shipped efe634b37, live v1.0.1149+).

Deployed-page rebuild bounce: bugs_open/006 §B records 'a single-page rebuild of an already-deployed page bounces to needs_human_review at attempt 0' — the reason the full-writer (needs_page) alternative was rejected; rerender_page_sections has no deployed-status gate (grep of the file for deployed/needs_human_review returns only the escalation path for missing content_data).
plan.risks: (1) A page whose stored content_data is missing/incomplete makes rerender_page_sections escalate the WHOLE page to needs_page → page-build-handler (its documented NULL-content_data path), which regenerates copy via the LLM — for such a page the 'light' fix silently becomes the writer rebuild. Bounded: contact pages on the 10 sites are writer-era with stored content_data, and the escalation is the action's own designed fallback. (2) The two dedup keys (contact_form_undeliverable:<page> for human-review, contact_form_undeliverable_rerender:<page> for auto-heal) mean a site that GAINS an address after a parked human-review row will get a rerender item while the parked row remains; the parked row is then superseded (reconcile_superseded_reviews already logs deploy-past-parked-review). Accepted: the alternative (one key) would let the stale parked row suppress the fix. (3) If sites.email is later blanked while forms are healthy, nothing regresses (the check only fires on broken actions; sanitiseFormAction leaves real destinations alone). (4) contactAddressResolvable duplicates deliverableFormAction's predicate rather than importing it (package boundary: discovery_checks must not import actions — it is imported BY it). Mitigated by lockstep comments on both sides and the parity test enumerating the same cases as the actions-package tests. (5) The reason 'section_data_resolved' is shared with other producers; if check_rerender_mode's routing set ever changes, this item follows that change. Accepted deliberately: a dedicated reason would require a config edit to the page-rerender agent that an agent re-seed could clobber (documented re-seed landmine), whereas the shared reason is seed-stable.
